parent_result.result: 67/76 TRUE hits at both budgets across Normal, Hard1, Hard2, and Hard3; 0/80 FALSE candidates; 65 source laws; zero 5-second-only hits.

target: Determine whether increasing only the production compact-fast wall-clock allocation from 3 to 5 seconds yields official marginal acceptances on the released 800 without losses, invalid attempts, or FALSE regression.

compact5_intervention.only_change: Replace timeout / 40.0 with timeout / 24.0 at the unique COMPACT_SUPERPOSITION_FAST production allocation site.

controls.paired_execution: Both arms run on every row in one job.
unchanged: all search limits other than compact-fast seconds

live_rivals.H_budget_margin: The 5-second arm gains one or both released Order-5 residuals, or another valid TRUE row, with no loss.
live_rivals.H_no_budget_effect: The paired accepted sets are identical; extra wall time is unnecessary.
live_rivals.H_timing_displacement: One arm loses previously accepted cases or results depend on arm order, indicating resource displacement or infrastructure sensitivity.
live_rivals.H_soundness_constructor: A judge call rejects, an accepted-set comparison contradicts the verifier trace, or the FALSE coverage falls below 400.

resource_budget: Two official runs per row, each with the normal 120-second solver boundary; one paired 800-row job with a 300-minute workflow cap.

metrics.required_floor: at least 788/800 and 400 FALSE acceptances in both arms
metrics.safety: zero compact5 losses, zero rejected/non-accepted judge calls, zero LLM calls

outcome_to_action.strict_gain_no_loss: Attack every marginal gain with isolated repetitions and metamorphic controls; promote the one-line scheduling change only if those pass.
outcome_to_action.identical_sets: Reject the 5-second change and retain the 3-second production allocation.
outcome_to_action.loss_or_invalid_judge: Stop promotion and diagnose displacement, timing, constructor, or infrastructure failure.
outcome_to_action.baseline_below_788: Treat the paired run as infrastructure-sensitive and do not interpret the score difference until the baseline is reproduced.
